people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

translations.web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.
translations.bsb: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Issachar, including these cities and their villages.
